mapper.sql: SELECT e.id, e.user_id, e.name, e.account, e.status, e.failed_attempts, e.locked_until, e.create_by, e.create_time, e.update_by, e.update_time, e.del_flag, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = e.user_id AND r.role_key = 'admin' AND r.status = '0' AND r.del_flag = '0' ) THEN 'ADMIN' ELSE 'EMPLOYEE' END AS role FROM smt_employee e
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.user_id, e.name, e.account, e.status, e.failed_attempts, e.locked_until, e.create_by, e.create_time, e.update_by, e.update_time, e.del_flag, u.password AS password, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = e.user_id AND r.role_key = 'admin' AND r.status = '0' AND r.del_flag = '0' ) THEN 'ADMIN' ELSE 'EMPLOYEE' END AS role FROM smt_employee e LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = e.user_id AND u.del_flag = '0' WHERE e.account = #{account} AND e.del_flag = '0' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO smt_employee ( user_id, name, account, status, failed_attempts, locked_until, create_by, create_time, del_flag ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{name}, #{account}, #{status}, #{failedAttempts}, #{lockedUntil}, #{createBy}, NOW(), '0' )
mapper.update:
UPDATE smt_employee
user_id = #{userId},
name = #{name},
account = #{account},
status = #{status},
failed_attempts = #{failedAttempts},
locked_until = #{lockedUntil},
update_by = #{updateBy},
update_time = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = '0'
UPDATE smt_employee SET failed_attempts = #{failedAttempts}, locked_until = #{lockedUntil}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = '0'
UPDATE smt_employee SET failed_attempts = 0, locked_until = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = '0'
UPDATE smt_employee SET del_flag = '2', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = '0'
UPDATE sys_user SET password = #{password}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = (SELECT user_id FROM smt_employee WHERE id = #{id}) AND del_flag = '0'
